versioning.displayVersion: legacy major.minor plus optional resource suffix through 5.18a; full semver thereafter
rules: Published display versions through 5.18a are immutable legacy history.
Viewer 5.18.1 is the first release after the 5.18a legacy cutoff; later releases use full SemVer and displayVersion equals appSemver.
Patch releases cover resources, thumbnails, settings, compatible routes, bug fixes, and other backwards-compatible corrections.
Minor releases add backwards-compatible product, interaction, loader, data, or architecture capabilities.
Major releases change public contracts incompatibly or require consumer migration.
Documentation, governance, research, behavior-neutral refactors, test maintenance, and unpublished staging do not create Viewer versions.
